name: The Biltmore Hotel Villas
positioning: Private-villa hotel in Al Barsha 1, Dubai, where each villa has its own temperature-controlled pool and an in-villa cinema, with private butler service
best_for: Travelers who want a villa with its own pool and cinema in Dubai
Families looking for a private villa with children's facilities on site

facts.text: The hotel is on 24th Street in Al Barsha 1, Dubai.
The villas blend modern finishes with touches of Emirati heritage.
Each villa has a private temperature-controlled swimming pool.
The property lists a gym, a private chef and covered private parking among its features.
Each villa has complimentary private parking.
There are dedicated children's facilities and activities.
The property holds EarthCheck Silver Certification and ISO 14001:2015 certification.
Currency exchange is available for in-house guests.
Dubai International Airport is approximately 27 km away, and Al Maktoum International Airport approximately 38 km away.

highlights.text: The villas have private swimming pools and in-villa cinemas.
Dedicated private butlers look after guests during their stay.
The Biltmore Spa offers Omorovicza treatments and botanical rituals by KOS Paris.
Brasserie, the restaurant at The Biltmore Hotel Villas, offers an international spread with premium coffees and teas in a space overlooking the villa courtyard.

considerations.text: On-site dining is a single restaurant, Brasserie.
Airport transfers can be arranged at an additional charge; Dubai International Airport is approximately 27 km away.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
